"I want to create a game inspired by PIMD but modernized and set in a cyber punk universe. Instead of it being college related with frat parties etc. I want there to be different factions and groups related to cyber punk era. I want there to be gangs or affiliates. I want the mobile app to be an Online MMO social game with world chat etc. You start out at with 3 different life baths. Street lifer (they start in an abandoned building etc.)
Corpo (start at the bottom in a blank and boring room) or a \"nomander\" a country put of city type. They have a trailer. Now these rooms arent actual rooms but just back grounds. Prior to tjis I want the person to choose thier gender type if they want a gender or a 3rd choice etc foe whatever. Then they get put into that life choice option.

---

Built **NEON VEIL** in `index.html`—a responsive cyberpunk social-game prototype.

It includes a character setup flow with four identity options, callsign, and three origins (Street Lifer, Corpo, Nomad), followed by faction selection. After entering the grid, players can explore Home, District, Crew, and Style views, browse activity cards, and send messages in the world chat.
